thread.title: Apple stock falls after hours as Trump mentions potential tariffs on iPhones

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Apple stock falls after hours as Trump mentions potential tariffs on iPhones
text:
Shares of Apple Inc.
 AAPL, +1.35%
 turned lower in the extended session Monday on the heels of President Donald Trump’s remarks to The Wall Street Journal about potentially expanding tariffs on Chinese goods and, more specifically, putting tariffs on Apple’s iPhones. Apple stock ended the regular trading session up 1.4%. While tariffs could be placed on iPhones as well as laptop computers imported from China, the administration was worried about a consumer reaction, according to the report. More broadly, Trump told the newspaper he expects to move ahead with boosting tariff levels on $200 billion worth of Chinese goods. Trump is scheduled to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping later this week in Argentina. Barring a deal, stiffer U.S. tariffs on Chinese products are set to go into effect Jan. 1.
